canonical_fixed_anchor_object.chosen_orientation: One orientation (c,f) only to name L/R.
canonical_fixed_anchor_object.flexible_SCC_poset: H = condensation DAG / reachability poset of D[F_star].
canonical_fixed_anchor_object.statement: Up to anchor reversal duality, the tuple ({c,f},z,F_R,F_L,H) is a compact normal form carrying all representation freedom.

representation_bijection.exact_map: For every upper set U of H, R=F_R union vertices(U) is a valid representation; every valid representation arises uniquely this way.

antichain_correspondence.theorem: For every finite poset, upper sets, lower ideals, and antichains are in canonical bijection.
antichain_correspondence.explicit_bijection_note: An upper set is determined by its set of minimal elements, which is an antichain; conversely an antichain generates its upward closure.

uniqueness_and_size.unique_representation: iff F_star is empty iff H has zero vertices iff |R_lattice|=1.
uniqueness_and_size.exponential_size_possible: A compact poset can have exponentially many upper sets; for example, an antichain on q flexible SCCs has 2^q upper sets.
uniqueness_and_size.consequence: Polynomial construction of H does not imply polynomial-size explicit representation list.

polynomial_tasks: compute SCCs and condensation DAG H
test whether a proposed representation is implication-closed / corresponds to an upper set
compute representation-invariant channel capacity from one canonical representation
algorithmic_firewall.enumeration_warning: Explicit enumeration of every representation can require exponential output size when |Up(H)| is exponential.
algorithmic_firewall.counting_warning: Counting antichains/ideals of an arbitrary finite poset is #P-complete in the general poset problem. Therefore the existence of a compact H does not by itself imply an efficient exact counting algorithm.
algorithmic_firewall.exact_channel_counting_complexity_firewa: Do NOT claim #P-completeness of counting exact-channel representations from this fact alone. Such a claim would require a separate realization/reduction theorem showing that sufficiently general posets arise as flexible SCC-posets of exact-channel instances.

capacity_nonbranching.theorem: Channel matching capacity is constant across the full representation lattice.
capacity_nonbranching.consequence: Neither enumeration nor counting of Up(H) is required to compute rho_G(c,f)=nu(X)=lambda_G(c,f)-1.

proof_carrying_outputs.representation_certificate: An upper set U of H; reconstruct R=F_R union vertices(U).
proof_carrying_outputs.membership_verifier: Check SCC-union and successor closure in H.
proof_carrying_outputs.nonuniqueness_certificate: Any flexible SCC; bottom and top give two distinct representations.
